component.name: Wazzup
component.summary: Chat on WhatsApp from your GNOME desktop
Chatta su WhatsApp dal tuo desktop GNOME
Discutez sur WhatsApp depuis votre bureau GNOME
Chatten Sie mit WhatsApp auf Ihrem GNOME-Desktop
Chatea en WhatsApp desde tu escritorio GNOME

description.p: Wazzup brings WhatsApp Web into a native GNOME window, with voice and video calls, desktop notifications and an unread badge.
Wazzup porta WhatsApp Web in una finestra GNOME nativa, con chiamate vocali e video, notifiche sul desktop e contatore dei messaggi non letti.

ul.li: Passcode lock with automatic locking when idle or hidden
Blur chats until you point at them
Downloads panel, spell checking and proxy support
Top bar icon, light and dark style, five interface languages

description.p: Wazzup is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.
